cmd.init: Creates a Git repository in the chosen folder and links it to a remote
cmd.commit: Commits and pushes, with an AI-generated message
cmd.undo: Cancels the last unpushed commit and keeps its changes
cmd.log: Opens the commit graph (branches, authors, details) in the browser
cmd.switch: Changes branch without losing your current changes
cmd.branch: Creates a branch and moves to it
cmd.deleteBranch: Deletes a branch, locally and/or on the remote
cmd.hotfix: Commits current work and creates a hotfix branch from develop
cmd.fix: Commits current work and creates a fix branch from preprod
cmd.cherryPick: Applies one or more commits to the current branch
cmd.rebase: Rebases the current branch on the latest develop or preprod
cmd.pull: Gets the remote branch, fast-forward only
cmd.firstPush: Publishes the branch for the first time, even if the remote already has a commit
cmd.pr: Opens a pull request for the current branch
cmd.fetch: Gets the references of all remotes
cmd.stash: Sets changes aside, or brings them back
cmd.config: Lists the options and lets you change them
cmd.help: Lists the commands and opens the full help
step.commitFlowIfDirty: the /commit flow if the working tree is modified
step.commitOrStashIfDirty: the /commit flow or git stash push -u if the working tree is modified
step.conflictCherryPick: if there is a conflict: git cherry-pick --continue | --abort | --skip
step.conflictRebase: if there is a conflict: git rebase --continue | --abort | --skip
step.forcePushAfterConfirm: if the branch was already pushed, after confirmation: git push --force-with-lease
step.firstPushDirty: if the remote has commits missing locally: the /commit flow or git stash push -u if the working tree is modified
step.prDefaultBranch: git ls-remote --symref origin HEAD (finds the default branch)
step.prPushIfNeeded: git push (or git push -u origin <branch>) if commits have not been sent
step.prOpenPage: opens the pull request page in the browser
step.hotfixDiverged: if develop has diverged: git branch backup/<develop>-<hash> then git reset --hard <upstream>
option.branches.protected: Branches that ask for confirmation before a commit
option.prefixes.hotfix: Prefix of the branches created by /hotfix
option.prefixes.fix: Prefix of the branches created by /fix
option.commit.addAll: Stage all changes before a commit
option.ignore: Files Git should ignore, with no .gitignore. Example: ["dist/","*.log"]
option.language: Language of git-push (en, fr, zh, de)
option.apiKeyEnv: API key, or name of the environment variable that holds it
option.web.port: Port of the local server (/log and /help)
